create_insecure_channel: create an insecure asynchronous gRPC channel to a server with optional compression and interceptors
create_secure_channel: create a secure asynchronous gRPC channel with credentials, options, compression, and interceptors
use_unary_unary_rpc: use a unary-unary RPC call on an async gRPC channel with timeout and metadata
use_stream_stream_rpc: use a stream-stream RPC call on an async gRPC channel with request iterator and timeout
close_channel_with_grace: close an async gRPC channel gracefully with an optional timeout for pending calls
